vulnerable.evidence: Prototype pollution observed via _.defaultsDeep constructor.prototype payload

fixed.evidence: No prototype pollution observed after malicious _.defaultsDeep payload

oracle.explanation: This oracle targets lodash prototype pollution in vulnerable 4.17.11 using _.defaultsDeep with a constructor.prototype payload, which is a known exploitable pattern in vulnerable lodash versions and is blocked in patched versions. It first performs a benign _.defaultsDeep call and only then marks operation_completed=true. After that, it runs the malicious call and checks whether Object.prototype gained oraclePollutedFlag. If malicious call throws after benign success, that is treated as blocked with operation_completed=true. Any setup/module/benign failure reports operation_completed=false.

attempts.explanation: This oracle validates lodash's public merge operation with a benign nested object first, then attempts a known prototype-pollution payload using __proto__. In vulnerable versions, _.merge({}, {"__proto__": {...}}) pollutes Object.prototype, observable via ({}).oraclePollutedFlag. In patched versions, pollution is prevented (or the call throws), so exploit_succeeded is false while operation_completed remains true. Any setup/module/benign failure is reported with operation_completed=false per requirements.
attempts.validation_reason: Expected vulnerable=EXPLOIT_SUCCEEDED and fixed=EXPLOIT_BLOCKED; got vulnerable=EXPLOIT_BLOCKED and fixed=EXPLOIT_BLOCKED.
